# Million Homes

Million Homes is a premium real estate agency based in the UAE and UK, specialising in luxury off-plan and ready properties in Dubai and beyond.

## About

Million Homes connects discerning investors — particularly UK-based buyers — with world-class residential developments in Dubai, including Palm Jebel Ali, Downtown Dubai, and other sought-after locations.

## Current Featured Development

- [Palm Central by Nakheel – Beachfront Residences on Palm Jebel Ali](https://millionhomes.co.uk/palm-central)
  Exclusive beachfront apartments and townhouses from £580,000. 1–5 bedroom residences on Palm Jebel Ali, Dubai.
